breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly does NOT treat the original x–y axes as principal directions. Instead, it properly applies the principal stress transformation formulas using the nonzero shear stress τ_xy = 2.667 MPa, computing the radius R and deriving σ_1 and σ_2 via the standard plane stress equations. This matches the ground truth approach, which removes the erroneous claim that principal stresses are simply σ_x and 0 when shear is present.
